text:
maria_cs: Quick ask 50k-user pilot next week, need a one-page "preflight checklist" for the customer covering: cache warmup, recommended batch sizes, streaming fallback wording, and a short renewal-risk capture form. Can eng + SRE propose safe defaults and copy-paste commands?

alex_eng: Happy to. I'll keep it customer-facing: short bullets, 2 copyable curl snippets (warmup + admin toggle), one-liner batching guidance, and a tiny smoke-test.

maria_cs: Customer cares about median latency <200ms and consistent quality. Also want a cron suggestion for low-traffic tenants to keep KV alive.

tyler_sre: Production-safe defaults: warm pool: 2 GPUs / 3 workers initially. Prefill: 8-12 unique prefixes per tenant. Batching guidance (simple): "qps <20 -> batch 4; qps 20-100 -> batch 8; high-concurrency -> batch 12, tune by p95 target." For 32k context models reduce by ~2x.

alex_eng: Warmup snippet (sandbox, copy-paste):

# parallel warmup, 8 requests
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-8k-latest","input":"Warmup #'$i'"}' &\
done
wait

alex_eng: Admin toggle example (ops only):

curl -X POST https://control.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/<tenant>/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -d '{"fallback_model":"rwd-2k-quant","reason":"latency"}'

tyler_sre: Circuit-breaker thresholds (customer-ready wording): "If p95 latency >500ms for 15 minutes OR error rate >2% for 10 minutes, system will automatically route to fallback model and CS will be notified." Recommend we expose a simple toggle in their console or give them the admin curl above.

maria_cs: Smoke-test steps (3 quick checks): 1) Run 5 canonical prompts (we'll send 3 examples). 2) Confirm median and p95 token-latency within SLA. 3) Verify top-1 answers for 5 samples match golden examples; record hit-rate.

natalie_cs: I'll add a one-paragraph renewal-risk capture form for them to send back: satisfaction (1-5), hit-rate vs golden, any recurring hallucinations (Y/N + short note), blockers for go-live. This flags accounts for early renewal outreach.

tyler_sre: Cron suggestion for low-traffic keepalive: run 6 warmup prompts every 15 minutes during business hours: cron: "0,15,30,45 * * * MON-FRI 09-17". Note: recommend keeping daily warmup token budget under 1k tokens per tenant to control cost.

oncall-bot: Note: control-plane policy changes must be scheduled at least 24h before production roll and deploy window is Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC.

maria_cs: Can you both drop the one-pager + snippets into #cs-assets by EOD? I'll attach prompts + renewal form and send to pilot contact Tue morning.

alex_eng: Will upload a PDF + the two curl snippets and a one-line batching table.

tyler_sre: I'll add the exact thresholds and the cron line in the runbook blurb.

maria_cs: Thanks all :thumbsup:
